correctness.rationale: The synchronous edge phase update is an exact coboundary: if the old oriented edge difference is +1, the head cannot advance more than the tail; reversal and the zero case finish the check. Thus extinction forces zero cycle circulation. Conversely the integral lift is monotone and bounded by the first multiple of three above its initial maximum: a site at that bound cannot have an excited neighbor. Stationarity then forces all phases to be resting. The open-ladder squares form an integral basis (face boundaries generate, or eliminate successive rail edges). Independently count extensions in the lift by setting the old rung increment to s in {0, +/-1}: new rail increments u,v each lie in {-1,0,1}, and the next rung increment is s+v-u in that same set. The counts of zero/nonzero next increments are (3,4) for s=0 and (2,4) for either nonzero s. Initial multiplicities are 3 and 6, so the trace and determinant of the reduced transfer are 7 and 4, with counts 9 and 57. These give the stated numerator, roots, and leading constant with the stated normalization by 9^n. A fresh reverse-reachability calculation on the full finite state graphs yielded 9, 57, 363, 2313, 14739 for n=1 through 5 (python3 /workspace/review_checks.py). The supplied verifier and recorded output were inspected, not executed. The finite check is not the infinite proof.
